description: DICOM Coded Entry as defined in IHE RRR-WF §40.4.1.2. Stores standard and deployment-specific code values used in UPS workitems (Scheduled Workitem Code, Processing Parameters, Report Requested, etc.).

fields.label: Codeset Type
fields.options:
Modality to Read
Specialty to Read
Report Requested
Workitem
Concept Code
Other
fields.description: IHE RRR-WF §40.4.1.2 table to which this code belongs.

fields.label: Coding Scheme
fields.description: DICOM Coding Scheme Designator (0008,0102), e.g. 99IHE, DCM, SRT, LN, SCT.

fields.label: Code Value
fields.description: DICOM Code Value (0008,0100), e.g. ReadCT, RRR001, Abdomen.

fields.label: Code Meaning
fields.description: DICOM Code Meaning (0008,0104), human-readable display string.

fields.label: Concept Name Code Value
fields.description: Code Value of the concept-name code item (the container) in the Scheduled Processing Parameters Sequence (0074,1210). E.g. RRR004 for 'Modality to Read'.

fields.label: Concept Name Coding Scheme
fields.description: Coding Scheme for the concept-name code item. E.g. 99IHE.

fields.label: Concept Name Meaning
fields.description: Human-readable meaning of the concept-name code, e.g. 'Modality to Read'.

fields.label: DICOM Tag
fields.description: Primary DICOM attribute tag where this code is placed, e.g. (0040,4018) for Scheduled Workitem Code Sequence.

fields.label: Sequence Name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the DICOM sequence that contains this code, e.g. 'Scheduled Workitem Code Sequence'.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive codes are hidden from UI pickers but retained for historical reference.

name: UPS DICOM Code
